speaker: Engine 7
text: Dispatch, Engine 7. We are at Main and Third. Main Street is blocked, debris across all lanes, no through traffic. Request heavy rescue to Building 14.

speaker: Rescue 4
text: Dispatch, Rescue 4, en route to Building 14, E T A two minutes.

speaker: Rescue 4
text: Rescue 4 on scene, Building 14. Partial collapse, north side. We have a strong gas odor at the north entrance, requesting utility shutoff.

speaker: Ambulance 1
text: Ambulance 2, Ambulance 1. Bridge Street looked clear when we passed it ten minutes ago, you should be good to go.

speaker: Ambulance 2
text: Dispatch, Ambulance 2, holding at Lincoln High School staging, awaiting a route to County General.

speaker: Dispatch
text: All units, dispatch. Caller reports large cracks in the facade at Building 22 on Oak Avenue, residents self evacuating. Treat Building 22 as damaged until checked.

speaker: Engine 7
text: Dispatch, Engine 7. We have visible smoke and flame from the rubble at Building 14, working fire. Requesting a second engine.

speaker: County General
text: EOC, County General charge nurse. We are open, twelve beds available, E R accepting walk ins and transports.

speaker: Rescue 4
text: Dispatch, Rescue 4. We can hear voices under the debris at Building 14, at least two people trapped, starting extrication.

speaker: Dispatch
text: Ambulance 2, dispatch. Traffic camera shows River Road moving, congested but open. Use River Road for County General.
